name: squarespace-mcp
description: Squarespace Commerce (ecommerce channels): me, end_listing, list_orders. Every tool maps to a docume

platform_mcp_squarespace_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_SQUARESPACE_API_KEY
platform_mcp_squarespace_api_key.description: Developer API key (Commerce Advanced plan: Settings > Advanced > Developer API Keys; Orders read, Products read) sent as `Authorization: Bearer`; the docs also require a descriptive User-Agent, which the runtime sends.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2/commerce/products (Products read) lists up to 50 products {products[{id, name, type, storePageId, isVisible, url, ...}], pagination}; verifies the key and shows the store's products.

tools.name: end_listing
tools.description: POST /v2/commerce/products/{productId} {isVisible: {present: true, value: false}} (the Update product endpoint's ChangeBoolean wrapper) hides the product; reversible with value=true. Returns the updated ProductV2. DELETE /v2/commerce/products/{productId} (204, irreversible) is not used.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: GET /1.0/commerce/orders?fulfillmentStatus(PENDING|FULFILLED|CANCELED) returns up to 50 orders by modification date {result[{id, orderNumber, createdOn, fulfillmentStatus, grandTotal{value, currency}, fulfillments[{trackingNumber, carrierName}]}], pagination{hasNextPage, nextPageCursor}}. Pagination is cursor-based, so `page`/`limit` are not sent (first page only); `since` is not sent because modifiedAfter is only accepted together with modifiedBefore.
